P: Serve dessert when Maleficent crashes the christening and curses baby Aurora.
S: Brioche with ricotta, honey, mint and Aurora's berries
Blackberries and raspberries tossed with honey and mint, spooned onto whipped ricotta on toasted brioche.
Black olive and caper spread on toasts, as dark as a raven
Pitted black olives blitzed with capers, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil into a rough paste, spread onto toasted baguette slices.
puff pastry with grated cheese and rosemary twisted into spiky sticks, baked crisp, smoky tomato dip

Puff pastry twisted with parmesan, black pepper and rosemary into spiky thorny sticks, baked crisp and golden, with a smoky tomato dip. Brush 2 thawed puff pastry sheets with beaten egg and scatter with 60g finely grated parmesan, 1 tsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary. Press in, cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each tightly. Bake on lined trays at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp. For the dip, simmer 250ml passata with 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 crushed garlic clove for 10 minutes.
M: Pork shoulder with crackling, apples and potatoes. No invitation.

Pork shoulder roasted at 160C for 4 hours with crackling, with roasted apples, potatoes and greens. Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and dry overnight. Roast at 160C for 4 hours, adding apple halves and 1kg potato chunks for the last hour. Blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles. Serve with steamed broccolini on a long platter.
You're my Fairy Godmother, says Aurora

Lamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, thyme and Worcestershire until rich, under fluffy cheesy mash baked golden and crunchy on top. Brown 800g lamb mince, then add 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, thyme and 400ml beef stock, and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Spread the lamb in a dish, top with mash, scatter with 60g cheddar and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Vanilla layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream, iced
Vanilla sponge layers stacked with jam and cream, iced in pastel colours and decorated with edible flowers.
K: Maleficent's green fire matcha lime fizz
Matcha, honey and lime over ice with cucumber ribbons

Matcha whisked with honey and lime, poured over ice and topped with sparkling water, glowing green like Maleficent's fire, with cucumber and mint. Whisk 2 tsp matcha powder with 100ml warm water until smooth and frothy, then stir in 3 tbsp honey and the juice of 2 limes. Fill 4 glasses with ice, cucumber ribbons and mint leaves. Divide the matcha mix between the glasses and top slowly with sparkling water so it swirls green. Stir gently and serve with a lime wheel.

steps.text: Score the pumpkin flesh in a criss-cross and rub with half the oil and the salt.
Roast cut side up at 200C with the potatoes and apples tossed in the rest of the oil.
Mix the panko with the chopped sage and melted butter, press onto the pumpkin and roast until the crust is crisp.
Steam the broccolini and serve on a long platter.

s.note: Brioche with ricotta, honey, mint and Aurora's berries
s.how: Toss 125g blackberries and 125g raspberries with a spoon of honey and torn mint. Whip 250g ricotta until smooth. Toast slices of brioche and cut into squares. Spread with ricotta and spoon the berries on top just before serving.

s.note: Black olive and caper spread on toasts, as dark as a raven
s.how: Blitz 250g pitted black olives with 2 tbsp capers, a garlic clove, the juice of half a lemon and a splash of olive oil until rough. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast until crisp. Spread the tapenade thickly on the toasts.

m.note: Pork shoulder with crackling, apples and potatoes. No invitation.

w.note: Vanilla layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream, iced
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice in pastel colours and decorate with edible flowers. Slightly lopsided is fine.
